content: The database was missing an index on the `reservations.expires_at` column. A recent release added a filter on that column, but no index existed, so the query fell back to a sequential scan, became very expensive, and caused the `INV‑E220` time‑outs that surfaced as `ORD‑5003` errors. (Stale statistics were also a factor, but the root problem was the missing `expires_at` index.)
name: gather
